title: Systems of Particles and Rotational Motion

topics.title: Rigid bodies and the centre of mass

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish pure translation from rotation and identify the motion possible for a rigid body fixed along a line.
Locate the centre of mass of a system of particles and of symmetric bodies.

topics.title: Motion of the centre of mass and linear momentum of a system

concepts.learning_objective: Explain that the centre of mass moves as if all mass were concentrated there and all external forces acted on it.
Relate the total linear momentum of a system to its mass and the velocity of its centre of mass.
State the magnitude, direction and properties of the vector product.
Evaluate vector products using unit vectors and use them to find areas.

topics.title: Angular velocity, torque and angular momentum

concepts.learning_objective: Use v = omega x r to relate linear and angular velocity.
Calculate torque as the moment of a force, r x F.
Define the angular momentum of a particle and relate its rate of change to torque.
State the conditions for translational and rotational equilibrium and the effect of a couple.
Apply the principle of moments to levers and balanced rods.
Explain when the centre of gravity coincides with the centre of mass.
Define moment of inertia and identify the factors on which it depends.
Define and calculate the radius of gyration of a body.

topics.title: Kinematics and dynamics of rotational motion about a fixed axis

concepts.learning_objective: Use the equations of uniformly accelerated rotational motion.
Apply tau = I alpha to bodies rotating about a fixed axis.
Calculate work and power in rotational motion.

topics.title: Angular momentum for rotation about a fixed axis

concepts.learning_objective: Apply conservation of angular momentum, I omega = constant, when external torque is zero.
